## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include screenshots for visible changes
when helpful.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Record relevant browser, indexing, or PDF
checks and anything left unverified.

## Review

- [ ] The diff contains only intended changes and approved public content.
- [ ] Relevant repository checks pass; any limitations are documented above.
- [ ] The user reviewed the changes and explicitly approved the push after review.

Push approval applies to the reviewed changes. Further changes need review and fresh
push approval as described in `AGENTS.md`.
